title: MapleStory: Idle RPG April 9 Patch Notes
author: Grendel
summary: The April 9 update added collaboration events, Ancient T1 weapons, chapters 37-38, Growth Dungeon stages, guild seasons, quality-of-life improvements, and bug fixes.

sections.title: Major additions
items: Added Ancient T1 weapons and Weapon Summon Level 18.
Added chapters 37-38 and expanded Growth Dungeon to stage 120.
Added collaboration events and two Guild Training Ground rounds.

notes: Structured summary verified against the official Nexon Forum patch note on 2026-07-27.
changes: Added The Kingdom of the Winds collaboration events.
Added Ancient T1 weapons and Weapon Summon Level 18.
Added two Guild Training Ground event seasons.
resolved_issues: Fixed Growth Dungeon retry, Zakum summon, Colosseum skill, guild ranking, interface, companion cooldown, and Party Quest repeat issues.
